status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

fixedPerRacePortfolio.win: 100 yen on top ticket by strict-OOS 164 win probability x JRA official win odds
fixedPerRacePortfolio.wide: 100 yen on top ticket by JRA official wide pair market corrected with alpha=1.0 mean strict-OOS top3 horse marginal log edge, ranked by corrected probability x official wide lower-bound odds
fixedPerRacePortfolio.quinella: 200 yen each on the top nine distinct tickets by JRA official quinella pair market corrected with alpha=1.0 mean strict-OOS top2 horse marginal log edge, ranked by corrected probability x official quinella odds

raceFeatures: locked 20 race-context/model-divergence features plus the fixed win/wide/quinella expert's top1/top3/top9 score, score dispersion, selected official-odds and selected official-market-rank summaries
raceReturnTarget: actual JRA total return divided by 2000 yen for the fixed portfolio, available only after the race date ends
raceScore: P(return>=1)+P(return>=2)+P(return>=3), an approximation to expected return clipped at 3x; extreme payouts above 3x do not receive extra selection weight
coldStartRaceScore: pre-race fixed-portfolio expected-return score summaries only
raceSelection: exactly five highest raceScore races per raceDate x venue; never fewer
